version.promotionalText: Record sessions with explicit consent, capture notes and tasks in the moment, and keep projects, goals, tags, transcripts, and follow-through together.
version.description:
Quipsly Capture keeps the moment and the follow-through together.

Record coaching conversations, podcast sessions, interviews, and field notes with an explicit consent step and a recording state that stays visible. Capture notes, tasks, goals, projects, and tags without leaving the session. When you reconnect, protected local work can sync to your Quipsly Nest so the same context is ready on the web.

Built for work that continues after the conversation:
• Start from Today or the project you are working on
• Record locally first with clear consent and source status
• Write notes and create tasks or goals while ideas are fresh
• Organize everything with projects and flexible tags
• Keep local originals until you choose to delete them
• Recover pending work after connectivity or app interruption
• Review transcripts and follow-through in Nest when processing is ready

Quipsly is designed to be honest about state. Joining a session does not silently start recording. Uploading does not mean a cloud copy is verified. A transcript or task is not marked ready until Quipsly has durable evidence.

Quipsly Capture currently requires an authorized Quipsly account. Some processing and cross-device features require an internet connection; local recording and protected recovery preserve your source when the network is interrupted.

review.credentialStorage: App Store Connect App Review Information only
review.whatToTest: Sign in with the supplied reviewer account. Open Today and Work; create a note, task, goal, project, and tag, then confirm the same records remain after relaunch. Open the supplied capture session, review consent, start and stop a short disposable recording, and confirm the local original remains in Library. Exercise an offline quick entry and retry after reconnecting. Confirm Account exposes Privacy and Request Account Deletion. Do not use private client, coaching, podcast, or unpublished source material.

shippingFacts: No advertising, gambling, loot boxes, open web browser, or public social feed.
No anonymous public chat or stranger matching.
The app can record and privately share user-provided audio, video, notes, and session work with authorized collaborators.
The app does not author violent, sexual, drug, or medical-treatment content, but user-provided coaching and podcast material may discuss ordinary real-world topics.
Social media capability is not exposed in the shipping iPhone app.

digitalServicesAct.recommendedAssessment: Likely trader if Quipsly is distributed commercially in the European Union; Apple may require verified public business contact details.

territories.expansionRule: Add countries only after support, privacy, tax, content-rights, and local documentation requirements are reviewed.
